test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 26

questions.question: The areas of three adjacent faces of a solid cuboid are 208 cm2, 289 cm2 and 117 cm2. What is the volume (in cm3) of the cuboid?

A, B and C, when each is working alone, can do a piece of work in, respectively, 11, 84 and 44 days. They all started the work together, but A left after 3 days. In how many days was the remaining work completed?

A trader offers a discount of 17% on the marked price of an article. How much percentage above the cost price should he mark the article to make a profit of 17%?(Give your answer rounded off to 2 decimal places.)
An amount of ₹800 is divided among three persons in the ratio 13 : 19 : 18. The difference (in ₹) between the largest and the smallest shares in the distribution is:
A woman travelled at a speed of 20 m/min for 93 min and at a speed of 73 m/min for 66 min. Her average speed (in m/min) is:

एक व्यक्ति ने दो प्रकार के सेब क्रमशः ₹2 प्रति 3 सेब तथा ₹6 प्रति सेब की दर से खरीदे। यदि उसने प्रत्येक प्रकार के सेब बराबर संख्या में खरीदे तथा फिर सभी सेब ₹4 प्रति सेब की दर से बेच दिए, तो उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या था?
The surface area (in cm2) of a sphere of radius 63 cm is: (Take π = 22/7)
P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 8 hours. If P alone can fill the same amount of water in 16 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the same amount of water?

Train A leaves station M at 7:40 a.m. and reaches station N at 4:40 p.m. on the same day. Train B leaves station N at 9:40 a.m. and reaches station M at 2:40 p.m. on the same day. Find the time when Trains A and B meet.

A man spends 16% of his monthly salary (in ₹) on the rent of his house. If every month, he also spends ₹136 on his conveyance and ₹4,510 on his grocery, and saves the remaining ₹898, his monthly salary (in ₹) is:
The average of the first 13 multiples of 5 is:3838
सचिन ने ₹89,125 की धनराशि को 20% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर पर जमा किया, जहां ब्याज वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। 2 वर्षों के बाद सचिन को प्राप्त होने वाली कुल धनराशि (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
शिवम ने व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए बैंक से ₹2,80,000 उधार लिए हैं। 2 वर्ष बाद 8% वार्षिक दर से उसे कितना साधारण ब्याज (₹ में) भुगतान करना होगा?
एक व्यक्ति को प्रतिमाह ₹9,598 वेतन मिलता है। वह प्रतिमाह अपने वेतन का 50% बचाता है। उसका मासिक खर्च (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
A cosmetic product is available at a discount of 11%. If the shopkeeper charges ₹1,513, what is its marked price (in ₹)?
The average of 13 numbers is 13. If each number is multiplied by 5, then what will the new average be?
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 8. If the first number increases by 40% and the second number decreases by 15%, the new ratio becomes ____________.
Find the curved surface area of a hemisphere of radius 63 cm.(Take π = 22/7)
The distance between two points on a map is 2 cm. The scale of the map is 1 : 363787. The actual distance (rounded off to two decimal places) between the two points (in km) is:
Pawan marks the price of his article 25% more than its cost price. If he sells the article for ₹5,830 after allowing a discount of 20%, then what will be the cost price (in ₹) of the article?
